say:1:1532001001:1.text: Hey! If it's weapons and armor you need, you've come to the right place.
say:1:1532001001:1.source_cn: 嗬，想要武器和防具，来铁蹄的工匠铺准没错！
say:1:1532001001:1.male: Hey! If it's weapons and armor you need, you've come to the right place.
say:1:1532001001:1.female: Hey! If it's weapons and armor you need, you've come to the right place.

say:2:1532001002:1.text: My family's been smithing for generations. Nothing beats our steel!
say:2:1532001002:1.source_cn: 俺家祖祖辈辈都会做这门手艺，雅库伯尔一大半的武器都出自...
say:2:1532001002:1.male: My family's been smithing for generations. Nothing beats our steel!
say:2:1532001002:1.female: My family's been smithing for generations. Nothing beats our steel!

say:3:1532001003:1.text: Whatever you're after, you won't find better!
say:3:1532001003:1.source_cn: 无论你想要什么，俺这里的都是你最好的选择！根本不用犹豫！
say:3:1532001003:1.male: Whatever you're after, you won't find better!
say:3:1532001003:1.female: Whatever you're after, you won't find better!

say:4:1532001004:1.text: I guarantee you this—in a thousand years, the Ironhoof tribe will still be forging the finest steel!
say:4:1532001004:1.source_cn: 俺可以和你保证，即使等到一万年以后，俺们铁蹄的手艺也不...
say:4:1532001004:1.male: I guarantee you this—in a thousand years, the Ironhoof tribe will still be forging the finest steel!
say:4:1532001004:1.female: I guarantee you this—in a thousand years, the Ironhoof tribe will still be forging the finest steel!
